name: Tropical Storm Hilary + Ojai Quake
summary: The first tropical storm warning ever issued for Southern California. Hilary brought record August rain, and a magnitude 5.1 earthquake struck near Ojai while the storm was overhead: two hazards at once.
glendale_link: Tests the compound-hazard case: flooding and shaking together.
